_about: AGPO rules. The single source for the backend (access/agpo.py) and the frontend (src/config/agpo.ts). Change a rule only after checking the source, then update last_checked.

legal_basis.text: Public Procurement and Asset Disposal Act 2015, section 157(5): accounting officers reserve not less than 30% of procurement spend for youth, women and persons with disabilities.

ownership.text: At least 70% membership of the group, and leadership 100% from the group.

common_documents.label: Business registration or incorporation certificate
common_documents.label_sw: Cheti cha usajili wa biashara au cha kampuni

extra_documents.label: Disability registration card
extra_documents.issuer: National Council for Persons with Disabilities

reservations._about: Who can bid on a tender, by its reservation. 'open' is any business, 'agpo' is any of the three groups.
